# fabric Provider

Terraform provider for the FABRIC testbed research network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credmgr_url` (String) FABRIC credential manager base URL. Defaults to `https://cm.fabric-testbed.net`.
- `orchestrator_url` (String) FABRIC orchestrator base URL. Defaults to `https://orchestrator.fabric-testbed.net`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) FABRIC bearer JWT. May also be set with the `FABRIC_TOKEN` environment variable. Obtain one from https://portal.fabric-testbed.net.
- `token_file` (String) Path to a FABRIC portal token JSON file. This supports automatic refresh using the file's `refresh_token`.
